_comment: Self-documenting manifest of the Duda content-editor fields for google-reviews (create these in Widget Builder with these exact keys). Duda passes every value as a string. Everything Elfsight's editor exposes is reachable through settingsJson, which takes Elfsight's own settings shape; the other fields override it so a new site can be set up from the panel alone.

fields.label: Google Place ID
fields.help: The business's Google Place ID (starts ChIJ…). Overrides sources[0].url in settingsJson.

fields.label: Google Places API key
fields.help: Places API (New) key, restricted by HTTP referrer to the site's domains. Google returns the rating, review count and up to 5 reviews.

fields.label: Reviews feed URL (optional)
fields.help: A JSON feed of the full review history. When set it is used instead of the Places API.

fields.label: Review language
fields.help: languageCode sent to Google, e.g. en, en-GB.

fields.label: Settings JSON
fields.help: Elfsight Google Reviews settings (or a full Elfsight widget export). Every look-and-feel option lives here.

fields.label: Only reviews mentioning (comma separated)
fields.help: e.g. a consultant's name — the Collins per-consultant widgets.

fields.label: Google Font family
fields.help: e.g. Roboto, Open Sans. Blank inherits the site font.
